title: Strict DOM lookups with no internal caller
question: Should DOMCoverage keep resolveDOMPointOrBoundary and resolveDOMRangeOrBoundary with no production caller, and should the strict findDocumentOrShadowRoot carry an assert name now that runtime code calls only resolveDocumentOrShadowRoot?

opportunity.reason: A bounded naming and deletion question on public DOM lookups; runtime code already uses the soft forms.
